# Samuel Adeyemi - Software Engineer & Builder

## Overview

Samuel Adeyemi is a software engineer, product builder, and technology enthusiast focused on creating modern web applications, SaaS products, and scalable digital experiences.

Samuel specializes in frontend engineering, full-stack development, and building user-centric products using modern JavaScript and cloud technologies. He has experience designing, developing, and shipping production-ready applications ranging from SaaS platforms to dashboards, marketplaces, and developer tools.

He is passionate about helping developers and students transform ideas into real products, sharing knowledge publicly, and building communities around technology.

## Featured Projects

### Quickli

Quickli is a food delivery platform designed to connect customers, restaurants, and delivery personnel.

Samuel contributed as a frontend engineer, building user-facing experiences and administrative dashboards.

Areas contributed:
- Customer interface
- Business dashboard
- Staff dashboard
- Frontend architecture
- UI implementation


### Tunu.io

Tunu.io is a digital wellness platform focused on personalized recovery and wellness experiences.

Technology:
- Next.js
- Zustand
- Tailwind CSS

Samuel worked on building the frontend experience and application structure.


### Certgo

Certgo is a web application that enables users to create, manage, share, and download digital certificates.

Focus areas:
- Product design
- User experience
- Web application development
